description: Generated by go generate ./internal/config from the struct tree; do not edit.

allowed_origins.description: Exact origins (scheme://host[:port]), no wildcards. Empty: CORS is off and no Access-Control-Allow-* header is sent.

idempotency_retention.description: How long the outcome of an Idempotency-Key is replayed (R-API-014).

max_request_body_bytes.description: Largest JSON request body of /api/v1/; larger answers 413 (R-API-017).

page_size_default.description: limit of a list request that sends none (R-API-010).

page_size_max.description: Largest limit; a larger one is clamped to it (R-API-010).

exempt_admins.description: Callers who hold the admin capability bypass the limits.

requests_per_second.description: Sustained rate; the window is burst divided by this, at least 1s.

allowed.description: The operator's ceiling. The runtime switch anonymousAccess (R-AUTH-040) takes effect only while this is true.

check_interval.description: How often a web replica looks at the password file for a rotation.

enabled.description: The one local account; disable it once an OIDC administrator exists.

password_file.description: Argon2id PHC hash or plaintext password; web replicas only (R-AUTH-042).

rotation_hold.description: Local login is refused this long after a password rotation was noticed (Q-AUTH-14).

enabled.description: Off breaks NuGet restore and _auth users; Basic with a password is impossible regardless.

nuget_api_key_header.description: Examine X-NuGet-ApiKey on the NuGet API-key endpoints (M2).

auto_redirect.description: Redirect the login page to the provider when exactly one is configured.

providers.description: Login providers by ID; see R-AUTH-004. Keys of an entry that are left out take the defaults of R-AUTH-004, R-AUTH-007 and R-AUTH-008.

device_code_failures.description: Wrong device user codes per user within auth.cli_login.ttl, cluster-wide.

exempt_cidrs.description: Client addresses or CIDRs that are never throttled.

failures_per_address.description: Rejected credentials per minute and client address, cluster-wide; a per-replica share while Valkey is unavailable.

recent_token_window.description: Throttle exemption of a credential validated on any replica.

starts_per_address.description: Requests to the unauthenticated row-creating endpoints per minute and address, cluster-wide.

revocation_bound.description: Revocation bound; at least 2 x cluster.epoch_poll_interval.

absolute_timeout.description: Ends a session this long after its creation.

idle_timeout.description: Ends a session this long after its last request (R-AUTH-010).

max_per_user.description: Concurrent sessions of one user; one more ends the oldest.

recent_auth_window.description: Credential-minting actions need an interactive authentication this recent (R-AUTH-011).

cache_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the four auth caches; bounds staleness only if an invalidation were lost.

max_ttl.description: Hard ceiling; the CI exchange sets the issued lifetime.

expiry_notice.description: A token expiring within this period produces one token.expiring event; runtime-adjustable.

allowed_groups.description: Empty: every user may create personal tokens; otherwise only members of these groups (R-AUTH-017).

retention_after_end.description: The token-cleanup task deletes a token row this long after expiry or revocation.

allow_non_expiring.description: Lets an administrator create a service-account token without expiry.

reads.description: Which reads are audited: none, denied (refused reads) or all (allowed reads too; the volume follows the downloads, Q-AUTHZ-5).

max_staleness.description: No decision is made on a grant index that was not confirmed current for longer; a request waits for a confirmation, then is answered 503 authz_stale (Q-AUTHZ-13). At least three times cluster.epoch_poll_interval; start-up refuses a lower value.

safety_ttl.description: Full rebuild of the grant index at least this often, jittered by up to 10 percent; it bounds a write path that changed an input without notifying.

hide_existence.description: A refused read answers 404, indistinguishable from a missing resource (R-AUTHZ-016, R-AUTHZ-017); false answers 403 for a resource that exists, for troubleshooting only. A repository's hideExistence overrides it.

snapshot_safety_ttl.description: Full reload of the repository snapshot.

unknown_repo_keys.description: Per replica: negative cache of unknown repository keys.

epoch_max_staleness.description: The invalidation readiness check; at least the readiness window of R-HA-008.

flight_lock_ttl.description: Extended every ttl/3 while the fetch runs.

allow_insecure.description: Permits ssl_mode disable, allow and prefer.

control_host.description: Control pooler host; empty means host.

control_name.description: Database entry of the control pooler; empty means name.

host.description: Host name; a comma-separated list is allowed (R-HA-009).

max_conns.description: At least 2: one is the control connection.

expected_web_replicas.description: Set by the chart on the migration Job.

expected_worker_replicas.description: Set by the chart on the migration Job.

max_elapsed.description: Request deadlines may cut it shorter.

session_host.description: Direct host for session-scoped connections; empty means host.

database_outage_grace.description: A replica that was ready stays ready while PostgreSQL has been unreachable for less than this; 0 disables it. Must be below database.retry.max_elapsed.

require_object_store.description: True makes the object store gate readiness continuously.

shutdown_drain_delay.description: Must exceed the edge's endpoint removal time.

watchdog_timeout.description: Bound for the watched loops of liveness.

retention.description: How long finished jobs are kept.

ops_listener.description: Also log probe and metrics requests.

redact_query_params.description: Query parameters whose value is redacted in the request path and in logged URLs (R-OPS-010, R-OPS-013).

ring_buffer_bytes.description: Upper bound of the bytes the ring buffer holds; the oldest records go first. A record above 16 KiB is kept as a stub.

advisory_lock_wait.description: How long to wait for another migrator.

abbreviated_time.description: Add the time map to abbreviated package documents, which pnpm and Yarn need for release-age policies (R-NPM-011).

document_max_age.description: max-age of the Cache-Control header of package documents; 0 makes clients revalidate every time, which a 304 makes cheap (R-NPM-013).

manifest_consistency.description: A request manifest that differs from the tarball's package.json: reject answers 400 npm_manifest_mismatch, warn stores the tarball's values.

max_tarball_size.description: Largest tarball of a publish; at most storage.upload.max_size.

max_unpacked_size.description: Largest sum of the unpacked entry sizes of a tarball.

retry_window.description: How long a repeated publish of identical bytes is acknowledged as the first one (Q-NPM-11); 0s turns the acknowledgement off.

role.description: Role of this replica: web, worker or all (local development only). No default.

blocked_content_types.description: Media types an upstream answer may not have where integrity.blockUnexpectedContentTypes is true (R-REPO-042); lower-case type/subtype without parameters.

remote_refusal.description: A remote repository refuses a name that a global claim covers, also when addressed directly.

fetch_wait_timeout_seconds.description: How long a request waits for another replica's fetch of the same path; after it the request fetches without the cross-replica lock (R-REPO-026).

global_offline.description: No remote repository contacts its upstream; the runtime switch cannot lift it (R-REPO-031).

lock_poll_interval_ms.description: How long a waiter for a flight lock waits for the outcome message before it checks the lock key again (R-REPO-026 step 4).

max_artifact_bytes.description: System value of limits.maxArtifactBytes: a larger upstream artifact is refused with 502 upstream_item_too_large (R-REPO-040).

max_concurrent_fetches.description: Per replica: upstream fetches in flight over all remote repositories (R-REPO-040).

max_redirects.description: Redirect hops followed per upstream request; one more answers 502 too_many_redirects (R-REPO-039).

merged_metadata_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: merged package documents of virtual repositories (R-REPO-020); 0 turns the cache off.

negative_l1_entries.description: Per replica: entries of the in-process copy of the negative cache of remote repositories (R-REPO-028); about 100 bytes each.

queue_timeout_seconds.description: How long a fetch waits for a free slot before it answers 503 with Retry-After: 5; 0 refuses at once (R-REPO-040).

lookup_wait.description: How long a request for a repository key that PostgreSQL knows and the snapshot does not waits for the change-log poll before it answers 503 (R-ARCH-011 step 2).

memory_limit_bytes.description: Container memory limit; 0 means none known.

memory_limit_ratio.description: Share of the container memory limit given to the Go runtime.

active_key_id.description: Key ID used for encryption; every listed key decrypts.

encryption_key_files.description: Key files: 32 random bytes, base64; the file name without .key is the key ID.

base_url.description: Canonical external origin; empty is allowed for development only.

content_base_url.description: Separate content origin (P1); empty means one origin.

content_url_ttl.description: Lifetime of a signed content URL.

endpoints.description: Further endpoints by name (R-EP-001): each needs listen and base_url. The entry default may set only hosts, wildcard_host, host_roots, wildcard_root, surface, auth, exposure, cache_fill, rate_limit_class and replica_header.

forwarded_header.description: The one header family the edge rewrites: X-Forwarded-* or Forwarded (RFC 7239). The other is never read.

listen.description: Client listener: UI, API, package protocols.

certificates.description: With inherit false: the ops listener's certificate/key pairs; empty means plain HTTP, allowed only while server.tls is plain too.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: With inherit false: client certificates on the ops listener; probes present none, so require breaks HTTPS probes.

client_ca_file.description: With inherit false: CAs a client certificate on the ops listener must chain to.

inherit.description: true: the ops listener serves server.tls's certificates, min_version and reload_interval without client certificates; false: the keys below are its own block.

min_version.description: With inherit false: lowest TLS version of the ops listener.

reload_interval.description: With inherit false: reload interval of the ops listener's files.

shutdown_timeout.description: Bound for in-flight requests and running work at SIGTERM. 0 derives it: runtime.termination_grace_period minus health.shutdown_drain_delay minus 5 s, or 25 s when the grace period is unknown. An explicit value must fit the grace period.

certificates.description: Certificate/key pairs (PEM). SNI selects the pair whose names match, wildcard certificates included; the first pair is the default. Empty means plain HTTP.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: none: no client certificate is requested; verify_if_given: a presented certificate must chain to client_ca_file; require: a client without one is refused in the handshake.

client_ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the CAs a client certificate must chain to (mutual TLS for the edge). Required unless client_auth is none.

min_version.description: Lowest TLS version accepted; TLS 1.3 is preferred either way.

reload_interval.description: How often every file of the block is read and compared by content. A changed certificate serves new handshakes within this interval.

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDRs of the edge that sets the forwarding header. A /0 prefix is refused.

hold_back.description: Tail withheld until the digest matched; 0 would release corrupted bytes before the check (R-STOR-013).

delete_settle.description: Also bounds, as half of it, how long after its object write an upload may insert the blob row (R-STOR-005).

ca_file.description: Empty means the system trust store.

endpoint.description: Empty means AWS endpoint resolution for the region. A host without a scheme means https://; plain HTTP needs http:// and allow_insecure_endpoint.

force_path_style.description: True for SeaweedFS, MinIO and Ceph RGW.

startup_check.description: Object-store conformance check before the first readiness (R-STOR-035).

max_bytes.description: Budget shared by all concurrent uploads of a replica; the chart derives it.

max_size.description: Largest upload; must fit spool.max_bytes on the roles web and all (a worker accepts no uploads).

bootstrap_anonymous_read.description: Until authentication ships, nobody holds system.read: true lets anonymous callers read /api/v1/system/info and /system/replicas. For the dev profile; removed with the identity work.

public_version.description: Expose the version to unauthenticated callers.

allow_insecure.description: Lets spans go to the collector in plaintext (an http:// endpoint, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE=true). Span metadata crosses the network unencrypted and unauthenticated; for a collector reached over loopback or a mesh sidecar only (INV-20).

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the collector. Refused with an http:// endpoint, where it would have no effect.

endpoint.description: Collector endpoint, e.g. https://otel-collector.observability:4318. https unless allow_insecure is true. Without user information: credentials go into headers_file.

incoming_context.description: trusted_peers: continue an incoming traceparent only from tracing.trusted_peers; all: from every client; none: never. A context that is not continued becomes a span link.

trusted_peers.description: Addresses or CIDRs of peers that set a trace context trove may continue (a mesh sidecar, an internal caller). Empty: every request starts a new trace. Never the edge proxy, which passes the client's header through.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed calls that open the circuit.

addresses.description: Sentinel host:port list; required in sentinel mode.

primary_name.description: Name in the Sentinels' monitor line; required in sentinel mode.

tls.description: Use valkey.tls for Sentinel connections too.

ca_file.description: Empty means the system roots (verify-full only); required with verify-ca.

server_name.description: Empty means the host name of each address.
